correctness.rationale: The exact Grassmannian chart imposes four cubic restriction coefficients. Smoothness eliminates one normal coordinate, leaving e^2*kappa(t), e^3*tau(t). The tangent-contact coefficient kappa is nonzero away from nine simple inflection points and has a simple zero at each; tau is a unit there. Thus completed local rings are the two stated quotients and no other lines exist. The Grassmannian tangent/gradient sequence gives conormal O_E(1), with square nilradical a sum of nine length-one residues; additivity of Euler characteristics on genus-one E gives 6n+12. The embedded standalone symbolic checker verifies universal expansion and explicit Fermat local identities; no finite enumeration is used to prove all smooth cubics.

value.rationale: The intrinsic Fano scheme of a classical cubic cone is a canonical Hilbert parameter space. The finding distinguishes the reduced elliptic curve from its generically doubled structure and the nine flex-controlled third-order residues, gives the exact nilpotent filtration and global Plucker Hilbert polynomial, and ties an embedded scheme phenomenon to elliptic 3-torsion. These are non-routine geometric invariants with mathematical use in degeneration and deformation questions; they are not arbitrary slices or a recomputation of a known finite table.
